title: AP2 BaaS Infrastructure Mandate Builder
description: Anchor agentic tool for Cat-14. Translate BaaS programme controls, settlement policies, and compliance obligations into a validated Policy Mandate JSON. Outputs Policy Mandate JSON BaaS mandate, human-readable policy summary, and agent instruction set for MCP runtime ingestion. Client-side. Zero PII.
